projects.title: On-Site Machinery Photo Inspection
projects.description:
I’ve just bought a piece of industrial machinery online and, before it ships, I want to see exactly what I’m paying for. I need someone in or near Santa Fe Springs who can visit the seller’s location and take a full set of high-resolution images that let me judge the machine’s true condition.

Please capture:

• Clear front and side views that show the machine in its entirety  
• Close, sharply focused shots of every visible serial or ID plate  
• Additional overview photos that give me a feel for the overall condition (paint wear, dents, leaks, rust, missing parts, etc.)

Natural light is fine if available, but bring a flash or portable LED so the serial numbers and hard-to-reach areas are readable. A phone is acceptable as long as it produces crisp, detailed images; a DSLR is even better.

Once you’ve finished, upload the original, uncompressed files to a shared drive or cloud link of your choice and label each image logically (e.g., “Front”, “Side”, “SerialPlate1”). No editing beyond basic exposure correction is necessary.

That’s all there is to it—just solid, honest photos so I can make an informed decision before the machine is crated and shipped.

projects.title: Nepali AI Automation Engineer Full Time
projects.description:
**The Role**

You inherit a system someone else built, work out how it behaves, extend it, and leave
it working. Most of the work here is not greenfield.

In your first months you would own features inside one of our production systems: a
video ad assembler, a static ad generator, a pre-lander builder, or the media buying
engine. You read code you did not write, extend it without breaking the parts already
shipping every day, and keep the cost per generated asset visible.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅**Essential**

- Strong TypeScript. You have shipped and maintained a Next.js application in production.
- Comfortable with a Postgres schema and an ORM (Prisma in most of our systems), and with

  the request path of a real web app.

- Practical experience calling AI APIs from production code (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar),

  including error handling, retries, and cost per call.

- You read the code before trusting the documentation, and you extend rather than rebuild.
- You write your own tests, and you prove a change did not break what already shipped.
- Working written English. The team spans several countries and most communication is written.
- Self-directed. You unblock yourself, and you flag a blocker early.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⭐ Valued, not required

- Python and FastAPI. One of our systems is a Python research backend.
- Vercel, Supabase, Clerk, database migrations.
- Media generation APIs (image, video, voice), and reasoning about credits and spend.
- Ecommerce or performance marketing background, Meta Ads, Shopify.
- Experience owning a system end to end rather than working a ticket queue.

projects.title: AI Voice Call Cost Optimization
projects.description:
We are developing a production-grade AI voice calling platform for the Indian market and are looking for an experienced Realtime Voice AI / Conversational AI / Telephony Engineer to optimize our existing architecture.
Our main objective is:
Target AI voice cost: approximately ₹3/minute per call while maintaining natural, human-like conversation and very low response latency.
This is not just an API integration project. We need someone who understands the complete realtime voice pipeline and can benchmark, optimize and redesign the architecture where necessary.
Technologies Already Tested
We have already experimented with:
OpenAI Realtime
OpenAI voice models
Sarvam AI STT/TTS
ElevenLabs TTS
Plivo
Twilio
SIP/telephony
Streaming STT → LLM → TTS architectures
Realtime speech-to-speech architecture
Our current implementations work, but the cascade architecture introduces noticeable latency, while our current realtime implementation is more expensive than our target.
We therefore need an expert to find the optimal architecture rather than simply replacing one API with another.
Primary Goals
1. Reduce AI voice cost
Current AI voice cost is higher than our target.
We want to reach approximately:
₹3/minute AI runtime target
while maintaining acceptable:
Voice quality
Conversation accuracy
Response speed
Indian language support
Reliability
Telephony cost, SIP/carrier charges, infrastructure and taxes can be calculated separately.
2. Extremely low perceived latency
The agent should feel like a real human conversation.
Target:
Customer stops speaking
AI starts responding as quickly as possible
Ideally sub-1-second perceived response
Streaming audio
No long silence before AI responds
Immediate interruption handling
We specifically want to avoid architectures where:
Speech → wait for complete STT → wait for LLM → wait for complete response → TTS → playback
creates 2–4+ seconds of delay.
Architecture We Want to Evaluate
We are open to multiple architectures.
Option A — Direct Realtime Speech-to-Speech
Customer
   ↓
Indian Telephony / SIP
   ↓
Voice Gateway
   ↓
OpenAI Realtime
   ↓
Customer
This is currently our preferred approach if we can achieve the required cost.
We want the developer to benchmark the latest suitable OpenAI realtime model/configuration and determine whether it can achieve approximately ₹3/minute through optimization.

projects.title: eBay Warehouse Policy Block Assistance
projects.description:
I run my eBay store from Guatemala while my stock is stored and dispatched from a verified third-party suppliers in the United States. eBay has now flagged the account with a “Warehouse Policy” block, preventing new listings and throttling sales. I need practical, step-by-step help to clear this restriction and keep the account fully compliant going forward.

Your core task is bypassing the warehouse policy block by identifying the exact documents, settings, or appeal wording eBay’s Trust & Safety team requires, then guiding me through submission until the limitation is lifted. Please bring solid, hands-on experience navigating eBay policies—particularly situations where the seller’s registered country differs from the shipping location.

When you reply, briefly show past work or case studies where you successfully removed similar policy flags or reinstated restricted eBay accounts, highlighting the results you achieved. I value evidence over theory.

Deliverables I expect:
• A clear checklist of every document or screenshot eBay will likely ask for (e.g., warehouse contracts, proof of inventory ownership, utility bills, return-address proof, etc.).  
• Tailored instructions or template messages for the appeal so all required data is presented in eBay’s preferred format.  
• Real-time guidance during submission rounds until the block is officially removed (or, if eBay refuses, a documented escalation path).

Once the restriction is lifted and my listings are live again, the project is complete—but I’m happy to add a milestone for any follow-up questions during the first month of resumed selling.

If you understand eBay’s internal policy language and have already guided other international sellers through this exact hurdle, I’d love to hear from you.

projects.title: Viral Content Research for Instagram/TikTok
projects.description:
# Viral Content Researcher for Instagram & TikTok

We’re looking for a **Viral Content Researcher** to help us find proven short-form content ideas for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

This is NOT a traditional scriptwriting role.

We don’t want someone sitting down and guessing what might go viral.

We want someone who can **study what is already going viral, identify the best-performing ideas for our target audience, and give us those ideas to recreate in our own voice and style.**

## Our Target Audience

Our ICP is **content creators and personal brands who want to grow and monetize their audience.**

They generally fall into two categories:

**1. Creators who already have a digital product**

They sell a course, community, coaching program, digital product, etc. and want:

* More views
* More followers
* More leads
* More customers
* Higher digital-product sales

**2. Creators who haven't monetized yet**

They already have a personal brand and create content, but they want to turn their audience into a business by launching a digital product, course, community, etc.

The common denominator is simple:

**They already create content and want more views, more audience growth, and ultimately more revenue from their personal brand.**

## Your Job

Your main responsibility is to **scroll Instagram Reels and TikTok and find proven viral videos that are highly relevant to our ICP.**

Examples of topics include:

* Getting more views
* Going viral
* Instagram growth
* TikTok growth
* Content creation
* Hooks and retention
* Personal branding
* Growing an audience
* Content strategy
* Monetizing an audience
* Creating digital products
* Selling courses
* Increasing digital-product sales
* Turning followers into customers
* Creator funnels
* Building communities
* Creator business models
* Content that generates leads/sales

We are especially interested in videos with **100K, 500K, 1M+ views**, but raw views are NOT enough.

We also want **outliers**.

For example:

If an account normally gets 5K–10K views and suddenly one video gets 150K, that video is extremely interesting to us.

Your job is to find these patterns.

## What You'll Deliver

For every piece of content you find, provide:

**Original video:** Direct Instagram/TikTok link

**Views:** Current number of views

**Creator:** Account that posted it

**Hook:** The exact opening hook/concept

**Core idea:** A short explanation of what the video is about

**ICP relevance:** Why our target customer would care about this topic

**Remake angle:** How we could take the underlying concept and create an original version for our brand

## The Most Important Rule

**Relevance > Views.**

Do NOT send us random entrepreneurship, motivation, money, or business videos just because they have millions of views.

A video is valuable only if the topic attracts the type of person we want as a customer.

Ask yourself:

**“If this video goes viral on our account, are the people it attracts likely to be content creators/personal brands who want to grow and monetize their audience?”**

If the answer is no, we don't want it.

## What We're Looking For

You should be someone who:

* Understands short-form content
* Spends a lot of time on Instagram/TikTok
* Can recognize strong hooks and viral formats
* Understands the difference between views and qualified views
* Can identify outlier content
* Understands creators, personal brands, digital products, and online businesses
* Has a strong instinct for what makes people stop scrolling
* Can research consistently without sending repetitive or low-quality ideas

Experience with viral content research, personal brands, creator businesses, digital products, or social media growth is a major plus.

## Our Content Process

The process is simple:

**You find proven viral concepts → We select the best ones → We record our own original versions → Our editors turn them into hyper-edited short-form videos → We publish at scale.**

You are essentially the **research engine behind our content operation.**

We don't need more random ideas.

We need someone who can consistently find **proven ideas that are already winning with the exact audience we want to reach.**

If you're applying, please send:

1. A short explanation of your experience with viral content research.
2. Examples of accounts you've researched or worked with, if applicable.
3. **5 example viral videos you believe fit our ICP**, including the link, views, hook, and why you selected each one.

The quality of those 5 examples will be one of the biggest factors in our hiring decision.

This can become a **long-term position** for the right person.
